title: THE DOOR
hook: do not open it|until you know
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: low drone, dissonant sustained strings, sparse metallic hits, unsettling, instrumental

beats.prompt: An ordinary door at the end of a dim corridor, single light above it, cinematic, unsettling stillness
beats.motion: The light above the door flickers once.
beats.caption: Every building has one

line.text: Every building has one door nobody opens.

beats.prompt: Extreme close-up of a worn brass door handle, hard side light, high detail, tension
beats.caption: The room is bigger than the building

line.text: In this one, the room on the other side is bigger than the building.

beats.prompt: A vast impossible interior seen through a doorway - cathedral scale, shafts of light, dust, cinematic
beats.motion: Dust drifts through the shafts of light.
beats.caption: Somebody is already inside

line.text: Which is a problem, because somebody is already inside.

beats.sfx: a distant echo in a huge space

beats.prompt: A single small figure standing far away in the vast space, wide shot, silhouetted, cinematic
beats.motion: The figure stands completely still. Dust drifts.
